overview: The Medford School Committee met to review vocational programming and plans for a health education curriculum review, receive updates on superintendent professional development, and hear an update on district personnel and ongoing labor negotiations.

items.title: Executive Session Announcements and Consent Agenda
items.summary: The committee announced the ratification of Kids Corner and paraprofessional contracts following an executive session and approved the consent agenda.

items.title: Superintendent's Report
items.summary: Superintendent Dr. Edouard-Vincent shared district updates, recognized student achievements, and highlighted upcoming community events.

items.title: Chapter 74 Vocational Programming Report
items.summary: District administrators presented an update on Chapter 74 vocational programs, detailing facility upgrades, grant funding, and increasing enrollment.

items.title: Health Education Curriculum Review
items.summary: Administrators outlined plans to evaluate the district's health curriculum using the CDC's HECAT tool and establish a comprehensive review committee.

items.title: Superintendent Professional Development Review
items.summary: Superintendent Dr. Edouard-Vincent reported on her summer participation in leadership development programs with MASS and Leading Now.

items.title: Personnel and Labor Negotiations Update
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent David Murphy provided updates on staff vacancies and collective bargaining, detailing the district's financial position regarding contract negotiations with the Medford Teachers Association.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: The committee expressed condolences to the families of William A. Carr Sr. and Teresa Piso Cardillo.
